description:
Client currently has a BI system developed using Informatica and Business Objects. Qlikview Developer will be  
 responsible for converting this into Qlikview platform  

 Job responsibilities include:- 
 - Defines best practices for modeling design, development and migration from Business Objects to QlikView. 
 - Work with other developers in building BI applications using Qlikview systems suite of products (QlikView Developer, QlikView Server, Publisher and  
 QlikView Enterprise Management Console).  
 - Develops, maintains, and enhances guidelines for overall architecture design. 




 
 Requirements
- 2+ Experience designing and developing BI applications using QlikView suite of products.
- Strong, hands-on experience in Inforamatica and Business Objects.
- B.A. / B.S. or equivalent work experience
- Excellent presentation and communication skills 

 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". 
- All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply.
 - Most of our positions require Candidate to clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment.
 
 SOURCER ASSIGNED:  Pete Tylor; Email: pete dot tylor at idealforce.com
